title: Graph Machine Learning: An Opportunity for Power Systems
abstract: arXiv:2608.16494v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Modern power systems face growing operational complexity driven by the integration of renewable energy sources, decentralization, and the need for real-time decision-making across a wide range of timescales. Addressing these challenges traditionally relies on model-based methods that, while accurate, can be too slow for operational demands. Machine learning (ML) has therefore emerged as a faster, data-driven alternative. As grid topology plays a central role in power system operation, graph machine learning (GML) methods offer a natural framework for incorporating topological dependencies as an inductive bias. We survey nearly 800 papers at the intersection of GML and power systems, covering forecasting, state estimation, optimization, control, fault diagnosis, and cybersecurity. translated_title: 图机器学习：电力系统的一个机遇
translated_abstract: 现代电力系统面临着日益增长的运行复杂性，这源于可再生能源的整合、去中心化以及跨多种时间尺度实时决策的需求。应对这些挑战传统上依赖于基于模型的方法，这些方法虽然精确，但对于运行需求而言可能过于缓慢。因此，机器学习（ML）已成为一种更快、数据驱动的替代方案。由于电网拓扑在电力系统运行中扮演核心角色，图机器学习（GML）方法为将拓扑依赖作为归纳偏置纳入提供了自然框架。我们调查了近800篇涉及GML与电力系统交叉领域的论文，涵盖了预测、状态估计、优化、控制、故障诊断和网络安全。电力系统为GML提供了一个异常丰富的基准测试环境，因为它们结合了严格的物理约束、多尺度动态、安全关键需求。
tldr: 本文综述了近800篇论文，指出图机器学习通过利用电网拓扑结构作为归纳偏置，为电力系统的快速数据驱动决策提供了自然框架，并涵盖预测、控制、安全等多个关键应用。
en_tdlr: This paper reviews nearly 800 papers, highlighting that graph machine learning leverages grid topology as an inductive bias to enable fast data-driven decision-making for power systems, spanning forecasting, control, security, and more.
